/* Generated by scripts/studio-paint (scene.json). The picture is a painted
 * original (public/images/studio/studio.jpg); this file only adds the light
 * on top of it: ceiling panels switching on, screens booting, rack LEDs. */

const PANELS: [string, number][] = [
@PANELS@
];

const SCREENS: [number, number, number, number][] = [
@SCREENS@
];

const LEDS: [number, number, number, number][] = [
@LEDS@
];

const SRC = "/images/studio/studio.jpg";
const SRCSET = "/images/studio/studio-sm.jpg 960w, /images/studio/studio.jpg 1920w";
const IMG = "absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover object-center select-none";

export function StudioScene() {
  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0">
      {/* lights off: the room in near-darkness */}
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img src={SRC} srcSet={SRCSET} sizes="100vw" alt="" draggable={false} className={`${IMG} brightness-[0.14] saturate-50`} />
      {/* lights on */}
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img src={SRC} srcSet={SRCSET} sizes="100vw" alt="" draggable={false} className={`lab-lit ${IMG}`} />
      <svg viewBox="0 0 1440 900" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full">
        {PANELS.map(([pts, d], i) => (
          <polygon key={i} points={pts} fill="#f1efff" className="lab-panel" style={{ animationDelay: `${d}s` }} />
        ))}
        {SCREENS.map(([x, y, w, h], i) => (
          <rect key={i} x={x - 1} y={y - 1} width={w + 2} height={h + 2} fill="#030308" className="lab-boot-cover" style={{ animationDelay: `${1.45 + i * 0.13}s` }} />
        ))}
        {LEDS.map(([x, y, d, t], i) => (
          <circle key={i} cx={x} cy={y} r={1.6} fill="#bfe0ff" className="lab-blink" style={{ animationDelay: `${d}s`, animationDuration: `${t}s` }} />
        ))}
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}
